_provenance.source: Federal Register API v1 (https://www.federalregister.gov/developers/documentation/api/v1). Public domain US government data.
_provenance.method: Retrieved through a web fetch proxy because the build machine had no direct network access. Each 'responses' entry is one GET of the list endpoint shown in 'request'; count, total_pages and next_page_url are as returned. The list endpoint's default field set omits comments_close_on, effective_on, docket_ids, regulation_id_numbers and significant, so those five fields were retrieved separately from the document detail endpoint (/api/v1/documents/<numbers>.json) for the same document numbers and merged into each record. Values were transcribed field by field from the tool output, not hand-written. No document was invented. html_url and pdf_url are the exact URLs the API returned.
